name: OpenAI
short: GPT and Codex models direct from OpenAI — pay-as-you-go API plus ChatGPT plan lanes (Free and Go include GPT-6 Luna).

plans.name: ChatGPT Free / Go
plans.notes: Free and Go plan users get GPT-6 Luna in the ChatGPT desktop app (Work and Codex); began rolling out to Free/Go Chat on 2026-10-08. No separate Luna quota published; standard plan limits (uploads, image generation, voice) still apply. GPT-6 Sol/Astra stay on paid plans.

plans.name: OpenAI API pay-as-you-go
plans.price: from $0.05/$0.40 per 1M (GPT-5 Nano) up to $21.00/$168.00 per 1M (GPT-5.2 Pro)
plans.notes: Cached-input and long-prompt tiers are documented per model.
